temporal_rows.note: London Plan 2021 remains adopted while the 16 July 2026 plan is draft.
Brownfield First Opportunity Areas are draft/strategic context.
Draft managed-release policy is not current parcel permission.
Do not treat emerging site layers as adopted.
No parcel score from borough delivery programme.
Collector date cannot substitute for local authority confirmation.
Zero applies only to the queried source snapshot.
End dates, replacement plans and updated boundaries must be checked.

score_gates.note: Every response requires SHA-256 of the exact raw body.
Every response requires an RFC3339 UTC fetch timestamp.
HTTP status must be recorded.
Content-Type must be recorded.
Body must parse as JSON before interpretation.
Any API error object blocks binding.
Request coordinate must equal the canonical point.
Canonicalised request URL must be retained and hashed.
Host must match the manifest allowlist.
Feature/entity count must be recorded.
Zero is source- and dataset-specific only.
Every positive requires primary council or authoritative-source cross-check.
GLA indicative boundaries require borough confirmation.
Adopted, draft, proposed, emerging and scheduled states must remain distinct.
Positive and constraint intersections must be retained separately.
Borough monitoring and delivery metrics cannot become parcel measurements.
Point-only datasets cannot establish affected polygon extent.
Duplicate or overlapping entities must be reconciled before scoring.
No score until the full candidate evidence batch passes.
Committed result must be read back from GitHub before acceptance.

runtime_controls.note: At most four official requests run concurrently.
Only one bounded retry after a failed first attempt.
Web Crypto hashes every raw response before export.
Export contains manifest identity, raw body, hash, timestamp and parsing status.

system_validations.note: Exactly 60 unique official query jobs are present.
Query and source hosts are restricted to official services.
Every job uses one of the three canonical WGS84 points.
Results schema requires raw SHA-256 and UTC fetch time.
Adopted, draft, emerging and scheduled states are distinct.
No score or confidence is emitted by the executor.
Unexecuted, failed or partial jobs remain NO_DATA.
